senses.gloss: for the formation of nouns in Kal, Peel, Afel (Hifil) &c., e.g. <cite ref="A01482"><he>אִסְפְּקָא</he></cite>, <cite ref="A02348"><he>אִיסְ׳</he></cite>, <cite ref="A02663"><he>אַפְטָרָה</he></cite>, <cite ref="A02665"><he>אַפְטַרְתָּא</he></cite> &c.;
demonstrative, e.g. <cite ref="A01180"><he>אִיהוּ</he></cite> = h. <cite ref="E00174"><he>הַהוּא</he></cite>; <cite ref="A02085"><he>אִנָּא</he></cite>, <cite ref="A01366"><he>אִינָא</he></cite> &c.

euphonic (prosthetic) <cite ref="A00419"><he>אִדְמָא</he></cite> = <cite ref="D00869"><he>דְּמָא</he></cite>; <cite ref="A01639"><he>אִית</he></cite> = h. <cite ref="J00674"><he>יֵשׁ</he></cite> &c., esp. before foreign words beginning with two consonants, e.g. <cite ref="A02415"><he>אִסְטְרָטֵיגוֹס</he></cite>, <cite ref="A02348"><he>אִיסְ׳</he></cite> = <cite ref="O00509"><he>סְטַרְטֵיגוֹס</he></cite> &c.
